# Astronomical 0.2.82
## Changes
- **Prefill memory exhaustion recovery for SSD streaming inference.** Streaming prefill chunk sizes are capped and prefill now recovers when a memory ceiling is exceeded mid-flight, so long prompts under tight memory ceilings no longer fail the request (#1542). - **Seated streaming engine performance and exact memory reserves.** When sparse mixture-of-experts layers are already resident in memory, the streaming engine removes per-layer host round-trips and handles routing on-device, bringing prefill and decode throughput closer to the resident engine. Context and reserve accounting is now an exact geometry-plus-measured-overhead projection, so admission under tight memory ceilings is predictable and no longer rejects work that would have fit (#1544).
No other user-visible changes ship in this release.
## Compatibility
- No configuration schema changes; existing configuration files remain valid. - No migration steps; models, caches, and settings are preserved in place. - macOS 14.0 or later on Apple silicon (arm64).
## Distribution
This release is distributed as a Developer ID signed, notarized, and stapled disk image. SHA-256 digests for every artifact are recorded in the release manifest, and updates are delivered through the Sparkle feed signed with the project's EdDSA key.
